Cash Grain Bids
Grain Bids are crucial for any farmer looking to maximize their returns.
Five Star Cooperative posts daily cash grain bids and grain futures on this page, delayed by at least 10 minutes. For real-time bids, contact your Five Star originator. Five Star Cooperative is committed to helping our farmers make informed grain marketing decisions. Our team provides transparent pricing, reliable service, and up-to-date grain information so you always know where your operation stands.
Cash grain bids and futures market data
At Five Star Cooperative, we provide up-to-date market data to keep you informed about grain prices.
Staying ahead of the curve means having access to daily grain bids, which fluctuate based on various factors. Our site offers a comprehensive overview of current grain prices , allowing you to make informed decisions about when to sell your grain.
*Reminder that posted bids are displayed at a 10 minute delay.

Iowa and Minnesota Area Grain Pricing
Five Star Cooperative specializes in providing detailed county grain prices and area grain rates, ensuring you know the specific value of your grain in your area.
We recognize the importance of farm location pricing and how it impacts your bottom line.
See grain locations
Grain Contracts and Payment Options
We offer a variety of grain contracts to meet your specific needs. Whether you prefer cash sales or deferred payment, Five Star Cooperative provides flexible solutions.
Learn more
Grain Delivery and Logistics
Five Star Cooperative understands that getting your grain to market efficiently is just as important as securing a good price. We offer comprehensive grain delivery and logistics support to streamline the process.
Our services include:
Coordinating grain transportation and grain hauling, ensuring your grain reaches its destination on time
Providing opportunities to utilize grain storage facilities across north Iowa
Handling the logistical complexities, so you can focus on what you do best
